verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device model platform, not an analytics product, so there is no evidence of a built-in insights or suggestions feature over a user's own data. Its platform API does produce AI-generated suggestions: POST /tool_schemas returns suggested tool definitions from a product description, and POST /generations synthesizes training data. Its models can also extract typed fields from messy text and embed sentences for search and matching, but that is a developer building block rather than an in-product insight experience. Missing for 10: an in-product insights/suggestions surface over user data (e.g. in the dashboard), docs describing such a workflow, and independent corroboration of suggestion quality.
